summary.text: Kate Lipper-Garabedian is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 32nd Middlesex District since March 2020 and is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts State Senate 5th Middlesex District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Lipper-Garabedian assumed office in the House on March 25, 2020, and advanced from the Democratic primary for the State Senate on September 1, 2026.
For the 2025-2026 session she chairs the House Ethics Committee and serves on the Joint Committee on Financial Services.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee.
